# External research material

This folder holds outside material that has not been promoted to project authority.

## Contents

- `Instagram data.md`: transcription of the announcement slides.
- `instagram comments.md`: social-media comments and reactions.
- `perplexity research deep.md`: broad external research output.
- `public website relased.md`: third-party article material about the challenge.

These files can supply leads, not mandatory rules or verified product behavior. Before relying on a claim, check its original source and record the claim, date, limitation, and status in `../../project-docs/RESEARCH_AND_DECISION_LOG.md`.
